## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Jùshě Lùn Shū* 俱舍論疏 (CBETA T41n1822) is a Tang dynasty 30-juan commentary on Xuanzang's translation of the *Abhidharmakośa* ([KR6l0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0023), T1558), composed by the monk Fǎbǎo 法寶 ([法寶](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E5%AF%B6), Tang), a student of Xuanzang. The text opens "沙門法寶撰." It forms the second of the three major Tang commentaries on the *Kośa* (倶舍論三疏), alongside 普光's *Jùshě lùn jì* ([KR6l0034](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0034)) and 圓暉's *Jùshě lùn sòng shū* ([KR6l0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0036)).

**Abstract**

Fǎbǎo 法寶 (fl. late 7th–early 8th century CE) was a student of Xuanzang who composed this comprehensive commentary on the *Kośa*. Like 普光's *Jùshě lùn jì*, the *Shū* follows the *Kośa* chapter by chapter in 30 juan and provides detailed Sarvāstivāda Abhidharma exegesis. The two commentaries differ in approach: where 普光 is more concerned with reconciling Xuanzang's translation with the Vaibhāṣika tradition, 法寶 at times shows greater independence in treating doctrinal questions. Both are indispensable for understanding the Tang reception of the *Kośa*.

The Tang Kōsha commentary tradition (三疏) — 普光's *jì*, 法寶's *shū*, and 圓暉's *sòng shū* — represents the full flowering of Chinese Abhidharma scholarship in the 7th–8th centuries and was transmitted to Japan (奈良 *Nara* period) as part of the *Kusha-shū* 倶舍宗 school. 法寶 is a common Buddhist name; this Tang Abhidharma scholar 法寶 is distinct from the Song Chán monk 法寶 who appears in [KR6q0288](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0288).
